products.name: Arc headphones
products.subtitle: Your own quiet corner.
products.description: A softer way to switch off. Arc pairs immersive sound with a sculpted aluminium frame, memory foam cushions and up to 40 hours of listening. Designed to feel as good as your favourite record sounds.

products.name: Mono speaker
products.subtitle: Small footprint. Full room.
products.description: Room-filling sound in one considered object. A compact wireless speaker with a tactile dial, woven grille and the freedom to move from shelf to shelf.

products.name: Orbit turntable
products.subtitle: Make time for the whole album.
products.description: An invitation to slow down. Orbit brings a precision belt drive, a balanced tonearm and a built-in preamp together in a beautifully simple turntable.

products.name: Dot earbuds
products.subtitle: Take a little space with you.
products.description: A pocket-sized pair for the everyday. Clear calls, comfortable listening and a softly rounded charging case, ready whenever you are.

products.name: Duo stereo set
products.subtitle: Two objects. One soundstage.
products.description: A matched pair of compact speakers that give your favourite music room to breathe. Simple wireless pairing and a soundstage that feels right at home.

products.name: Arc studio
products.subtitle: Hear the details you missed.
products.description: Reference listening, rethought for everyday comfort. Our next generation of Arc brings an open soundstage and a replaceable cable to a familiar silhouette.

products.name: Loop turntable
products.subtitle: An everyday ritual, refined.
products.description: A welcoming first step into vinyl. Automatic playback, an easy setup and a considered shape that fits almost anywhere.

products.name: Mono mini
products.subtitle: Sound that follows you.
products.description: Our original portable speaker. A little companion for slow mornings and long afternoons, with a rechargeable battery and a woven carry loop.
